title: Ranma ½
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: Teen martial artist Ranma Saotome fell into a cursed spring in China and now turns into a girl when splashed with cold water; his father becomes a panda. Their fathers' old pact engages Ranma to Akane Tendo so the two can inherit the family dojo, though neither wants it. Rivals, suitors and more cursed people pile up in a long-running slapstick martial-arts romantic comedy.
life_message: Pride and stubbornness get in the way of love; loyalty and honest feelings matter more than winning every fight.
